canonical_project: Wigner Data Centre (CERN remote Tier-0 extension)
owner: HUN-REN Wigner Research Centre for Physics / CERN
notes: CERN primary press release (2013-06-13): Wigner Data Centre in Budapest inaugurated as extension of CERN computing resources with about 500 servers, 20,000 computing cores, 5.5 PB storage. Wigner states the data centre was built with 4 MW IT capacity and 2x100 Gbit/s connection to CERN, hosting CERN Tier-0 equipment since January 2013. Research/HPC facility, not commercial colo. 4 MW capacity claim kept in notes (B-grade corroboration).
